summary.zh: 在快翻、常规、精翻三档间翻译文章
summary.en: Translate articles in three depth modes

description.zh: 支持中英互译，可在快翻、常规、精翻三档之间选择，也能挂自定义术语表。适合翻译外文长文、做本地化，或把已有译文再打磨一遍。抓取链接内容需要联网。
description.en: Translates text or a linked page between Chinese and English in quick, normal or refined mode, with optional custom glossaries. Good for long articles, localization or tightening a draft. Fetching a URL needs network access.
